alt: WV quickly starts packing everything into the pumps. Serenity blinks: HURRY UP! WV assembles the ruler-knife weapon. Serenity blinks: IS THIS REALLY NECESSARY? WV eats the top of the pumpkin. Serenity blinks: THIS IS INCREDIBLY SILLY! WV begins to ascend the rungs to the surface.. then tumbles back down to the ground. All of the items hit them in the head. The dunce cap visual appropriately reappears. PSYCHE??
